Upper Text: [Start of Your Main Phase] Place 1 Digimon card with the [Cyborg] or [Machine] trait from your trash as the bottom digivolution card of this Digimon.
[All Turns] This Digimon gains all the effects of [Machinedramon] and [Chaosdramon] in this Digimon's digivolution cards.
[All Turns][Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would be deleted, trash the top card of your opponent's security stack.
